messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — acct ACME corp POC wrapping tomorrow. Need a quick checklist for teardown: revoke hosted API keys, free dedicated pool, and remove VPC peering. Who owns steps + signoff?

devin_se: I can coordinate. For hosted keys we usually rotate + revoke the POC key and issue confirmation to customer. Quick command we run: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"key_id":"kp-POC123"}'```

maria_sales: perfect, thanks. we also promised them data wipe within 7 days — what's our retention policy for POC logs/models?

jonah_security: Standard is 30 days for pseudo-prod logs, but POC-sensitive data we can accelerate. For ACME we agreed to 7 days if legal approves. Need signed request from the customer or CSM.

kevin_csm: I have the customer's written request in the ticket (linked) — will attach and confirm. I'll also double-check whether any eval datasets linger in the Dedicated pool storage.

 tanya_infra: For Dedicated pool teardown: steps are 1) drain pool 2) snapshot any pinned models (we won't snapshot without explicit consent) 3) delete pool. CLI snippet: ```redwood pool drain --id rp-acme-01 && redwood pool delete --id rp-acme-01 --force``` After delete we also reclaim GPUs which may take ~10m.

maria_sales: do we need a maintenance window? Customer is ok with brief disruption.

 tanya_infra: Not strictly, but I'll schedule it for tomorrow 02:00 UTC to reduce impact. I'll post before/after in this thread.

jonah_security: Also: revoke any service principals created for their VPC peering and remove IAM roles used for the POC. For Private/VPC teardown: remove peering, revoke tunnel certs, and rotate any shared secrets. Example to revoke tunnel certs: ```ssh-keytool revoke --cert acme-tunnel.pem```

maria_sales: who signs off once all steps complete?

kevin_csm: I'll confirm with the customer and sign off on the ticket. devin, can you do a quick QA check after infra deletes? Just ensure no active keys and that API returns 404 for the model endpoints.

devin_se: Yup. After revocation I'll run: ```curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer kp-POC123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` expecting 401/403. Then check pool list: ```redwood pool list --project acme``` expecting no rp-acme-01.

maria_sales: any billing cleanup? We want to make sure they don't get charged accidental reserved capacity.

 tanya_infra: I'll remove the reservation in billing and mark the contract POC-complete. Finance notification will trigger automatically.

deploy-bot: scheduled job: auto-backup of rp-acme-01 config will run at 01:58 UTC — aborting backup per request.

jonah_security: One last thing: redact customer identifiers from logs before handing over any artifacts. Use the scrub tool: ```redwood scrub logs --project acme --since 2026-01-01```

maria_sales: awesome. plan: tanya will delete pool 02:00 UTC, jonah rotates/revokes certs, devin runs API/keys check, kevin confirms customer signoff + data-wipe note. I'll close ticket once kevin confirms. :white_check_mark:

kevin_csm: I'll post final confirmation here when done.

maria_sales: thanks everyone :heart:

kevin_csm: Confirmed — ACME POC resources removed, hosted key kp-POC123 revoked, dedicated pool rp-acme-01 deleted, VPC peering removed. Customer provided signed data-wipe request and we executed 7-day retention policy. Closing now. :thumbsup:
